# Icon provenance

- Set: **Lucide** `lucide-static` v1.52.0 (ISC licence, see `LICENSE`).
- Normalization: Triage spec applied — 24×24 viewBox, `fill=none`, `stroke=currentColor`,
  stroke-width 1.7, round caps/joins. Path data unchanged from upstream.
- Curated to 174 glyphs in 9 categories (`tools/vendor_icons.py` holds the list).
- Original mail-triage names are preserved as aliases (`tools/build_icons.py`).
- Regenerate: `npm pack lucide-static`, extract, `python3 tools/vendor_icons.py --from <dir>`,
  then `python3 tools/build_icons.py`.
